items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: The record I made over in Barbados was done with Bucky, Major Holly, Butch Miles, Rick Wilkins on tenor, and myself

ctx.x: Well why would he — conversely why would he fire somebody at a moment’s notice? Do you know? © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

Well sometimes people were taken to task. I never really saw him lose his temper, but Hank Jones, who is my favorite pianist, I mean he was so beautiful, incredible player, and Dick feels the same way, on that record, you know, he’s on that record that I sent you. He was booked to be with us at some special function for the government and didn’t show up. He told Benny that he’d been held up at the George Washington Bridge and couldn’t make it. Benny called the New York Port Authority and found out there was no…
He said, what? I didn’t follow you.
